{{Quote|Scavengers can be seen stealing the various parts from the destroyed Rebel Base in the system. Officials say they're going to put a stop to this as soon as possible. But will they be able to?|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>}}
'''Legacy YT Indigo Blue''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]],<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The Legacy YT Indigo Blue station was the first settlement inhabited by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the Dantooine system,<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" /> even before the Rebels built their [[Dantooine base/Legends|main base]] on the surface of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="ANH" /> Hence, it became the first target of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when it moved forces in the system<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH" /> The Indigo Blue station was left in ruins. It later became a stopover point for traffic passing through the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" /> The ruins of the station were extensively looted by [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWG_JTL_Concept_Art_5.jpg|thumb|180px|right|Concept art of Rebel space stations for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''.]]
Legacy YT Indigo Blue appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Legacy YT Indigo Blue was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:LYTIB" />
